display_name: NVIDIA Ampere sm_86 (RTX 30xx / A10 / A40 / A6000)

machine_profiles.evidence_scope: Local NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (16 SM, sm_86, WSL2 /dev/dxg, CUDA 13.1, Triton 3.9.0) timer resolution, cp.async/mma PTX/SASS, and closed-loop Triton GEMM verification.

profiler.note: On bare-metal Linux sm_86, request 200 kHz nsys GPU metrics; on WSL2 /dev/dxg or unprivileged containers where GPU PMU counters are blocked, software timelines remain verified with automatic WP_TIMER=1 (%clock64 + %globaltimer anchors, ~27 ns step) to avoid consumer sm_86 1024 ns %globaltimer quantization.
